caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate teapot positioned centrally against a plain, light background. The teapot is rendered in shades of gray and blue, suggesting a metallic, possibly silver material. It features a high, domed lid with a round finial at the top, decorated with a small ornamental knob and leaf-like embellishments. The body of the teapot is rounded and slightly tapering towards the base, with elaborate embossed floral patterns and a prominent shield-shaped cartouche framed by scrollwork on the side. Around the shoulder, there is a decorative band of circular details. The handle is large, curved, and intricately designed, with multiple ridges and a small thumb rest at the top. The spout is elongated, tapering smoothly outward from the body. The teapot is supported by four ornate, curved legs with decorative detailing at the joints and feet. The drawing is executed with careful attention to shading and detail to create a sense of dimensionality and texture. The artist's signature, "HARRY MANN WANDELL," appears in small text at the bottom right corner.
title: Silver Teapot
